title: GenerateL1 executor
description: Generates L1 Resource/Component TypeScript source from vendored provider JSON Schema files, in-process via @cdk-x/generator-toolkit.

apiVersion.description: The cdkx-owned API group and version shared by every Resource this executor generates, e.g. "github.cdk-x.com/v1".

outputDir.description: Directory generated *.generated.ts / *.deploy.generated.ts files are written to, relative to the project root.

schemas.description: One entry per vendored JSON Schema file to generate L1 output from.

file.description: Path to the vendored schema file, relative to the project root.

resourceType.description: PascalCase resource type name for this schema's root, e.g. "Workflow".

mode.description: "synth-only" for a Resource whose synthesized properties become a file with no live API call; "deploy" for one created via a provider API call.
